entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the date you arrive in Nauru.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de caducidad al menos 3 meses posterior a la fecha de llegada a Nauru.
entry.quote: To enter Nauru, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You must have a visa to visit Nauru.
entry.es: Se necesita visado para visitar Nauru.
entry.quote: You must have a visa to visit Nauru.

entry.en: All foreign visitors need a valid passport and proof of hotel booking or a local sponsor to enter Nauru.
entry.es: Todos los visitantes extranjeros necesitan pasaporte válido y prueba de reserva de hotel o de un patrocinador local para entrar en Nauru.
entry.quote: All foreign visitors require a valid passport and proof of hotel booking or local sponsor in order to enter Nauru.

entry.en: A tourist visa reportedly costs $100, with prices in Australian dollars.
entry.es: Según se informa, un visado de turista cuesta 100 $, con precios en dólares australianos.
entry.quote: A tourist visa reportedly costs $100 (all prices in Australian dollars).

entry.en: Proof of yellow fever vaccination is needed if you come from or have in the last six days visited a country where yellow fever is endemic.
entry.es: Se necesita prueba de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país con fiebre amarilla endémica o lo has visitado en los últimos seis días.
entry.quote: If you come from a country where yellow fever is endemic or you've visited such a country in the last six days, you need to have proof of yellow fever vaccination.

entry.en: There are controls on taking plants or animals into Nauru.
entry.es: Hay controles sobre la entrada de plantas o animales en Nauru.
entry.quote: There are controls on taking plants or animals into Nauru.

safety.en: Nauru is described as a peaceful island where all kinds of crime are very rare.
safety.es: Nauru se describe como una isla pacífica donde todo tipo de delitos son muy raros.
safety.quote: Nauru is a peaceful island and all kinds of crime are very rare.

safety.en: Although there is no recent history of terrorism in Nauru, attacks cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: Aunque no hay historial reciente de terrorismo en Nauru, no se pueden descartar atentados.
safety.quote: Although there is no recent history of terrorism in Nauru, attacks cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Severe penalties, including custodial sentences, apply for drug offences.
safety.es: Se aplican penas severas, incluidas penas de cárcel, por delitos de drogas.
safety.quote: Do not get involved with illegal drugs of any kind. There are severe penalties including custodial sentences for drug offences.

safety.en: Same-sex relationships are legal, but society is conservative and public affection between same-sex partners may cause offence.
safety.es: Las relaciones entre personas del mismo sexo son legales, pero la sociedad es conservadora y las muestras públicas de afecto pueden ofender.
safety.quote: Same-sex relationships are legal, but Nauru society is conservative and same-sex partners showing affection in public may cause offence.

safety.en: Wild dogs roam all around Nauru and are described as dangerous.
safety.es: Hay perros salvajes por toda Nauru y se describen como peligrosos.
safety.quote: There are wild dogs roaming all around Nauru. They are dangerous, and locals have been warned not to walk along dark roads at night.

safety.en: During the rainy season from November to May there is a risk of strong winds, sea swells and tropical cyclones.
safety.es: Durante la temporada de lluvias, de noviembre a mayo, hay riesgo de vientos fuertes, oleaje y ciclones tropicales.
safety.quote: During the rainy season from November to May, there’s a risk of strong winds, sea swells and tropical cyclones.

health.en: The emergency number for an ambulance is 111.
health.es: El número de emergencias para una ambulancia es el 111.
health.quote: Call 111 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Medical facilities in Nauru are very basic, and you may need medical evacuation to Australia by air ambulance.
health.es: Los centros médicos de Nauru son muy básicos y puede que necesites una evacuación médica a Australia en ambulancia aérea.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Nauru are very basic. You may need medical evacuation to Australia by air ambulance.

health.en: Supplies of basic and prescription medicines are limited, so you should bring enough for your whole trip.
health.es: El suministro de medicamentos básicos y con receta es limitado, así que conviene llevar suficientes para todo el viaje.
health.quote: Supplies of basic and prescription medicines are limited on Nauru, so bring enough to last your whole trip.

health.en: Visitors have been bitten by stray dogs.
health.es: Hay visitantes que han sido mordidos por perros callejeros.
health.quote: Visitors have been bitten by stray dogs.

health.en: Water relies on rainwater tanks and an aging desalination plant, and you should avoid tap water.
health.es: El agua depende de aljibes de lluvia y de una planta desalinizadora envejecida, y se debe evitar el agua del grifo.
health.quote: Water supply in Nauru is dependent on rainwater collected into tanks from the roofs of houses and from an aging reverse osmosis desalination plant. You should avoid tap water.

health.en: There is a risk of dengue fever, so you should protect yourself from mosquito bites.
health.es: Existe riesgo de dengue, por lo que conviene protegerse de las picaduras de mosquitos.
health.quote: There is a risk of dengue fever, though, so you should protect yourself from mosquito bites.

help.en: The emergency numbers are 111 for ambulance, 112 for fire and 110 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son el 111 para ambulancia, el 112 para bomberos y el 110 para policía.

help.en: You can call FCDO in London 24 hours a day on 020 7008 5000 if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Puedes llamar al FCDO en Londres las 24 horas al 020 7008 5000 si algo le ha ocurrido a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote:
You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

Telephone: 020 7008 5000 (24 hours)

getting_in.en: Nauru International Airport (INU) is in the Yaren district, and virtually everyone arrives and departs there.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Nauru (INU) está en el distrito de Yaren y prácticamente todo el mundo llega y sale por allí.
getting_in.quote: Nauru International Airport (INU  IATA) (in the Yaren district in the southwest of the island). Virtually everyone arrives here and departs from here.

getting_in.en: As of 2023, Nauru Airlines flies to Nauru from Brisbane, Nadi, Pohnpei and Honiara.
getting_in.es: En 2023, Nauru Airlines volaba a Nauru desde Brisbane, Nadi, Pohnpei y Honiara.
getting_in.quote: As of 2023, the national carrier, Nauru Airlines (formerly known as Our Airline and Air Nauru), flies to Nauru from Brisbane, Nadi, Pohnpei and Honiara.

getting_in.en: Flights are rather irregular, with each destination served one to three times a week.
getting_in.es: Los vuelos son bastante irregulares, y cada destino cuenta con uno a tres vuelos por semana.
getting_in.quote: Flights are rather irregular, with each destination being served one to three times a week.

getting_in.en: You should probably plan and book your trip a few months ahead because of the visa requirement and full flights.
getting_in.es: Conviene planificar y reservar el viaje con unos meses de antelación por el requisito de visado y los vuelos llenos.
getting_in.quote: This, in combination with the visa requirement, means that you probably should plan and book your trip a few months ahead.

getting_in.en: The ports in Aiwo and Anibare cannot accommodate passenger traffic or yachts.
getting_in.es: Los puertos de Aiwo y Anibare no admiten tráfico de pasajeros ni yates.
getting_in.quote: Neither of the two ports in Aiwo and Anibare can accommodate passenger traffic or yachts

getting_in.en: The hotel may or may not send a car to pick you up at the airport, and in the worst case you'll have to walk.
getting_in.es: Puede que el hotel envíe o no un coche a recogerte al aeropuerto y, en el peor de los casos, tendrás que ir andando.
getting_in.quote: The hotel may or may not send a car to pick you up at the airport; in the worst case you'll have to walk.

getting_around.en: There is hardly any public transportation, so renting a car, scooter or bike is the best bet.
getting_around.es: Casi no hay transporte público, así que lo mejor es alquilar un coche, una moto o una bici.
getting_around.quote: There's hardly any public transportation, so your best bet to get around would be in a rented vehicle; car, scooter or bike.

getting_around.en: A community bus circles the island about every hour during the day and costs 50 cents per trip.
getting_around.es: Un autobús comunitario recorre la isla aproximadamente cada hora durante el día y cuesta 50 centavos por trayecto.
getting_around.quote: There is a community or island bus which travels around the island every hour or so during the day. It costs 50 cents per trip around the island.

getting_around.en: It takes less than one hour to drive right around Nauru.
getting_around.es: Se tarda menos de una hora en dar la vuelta a Nauru en coche.
getting_around.quote: Nauru is so small that it takes less than one hour to drive right around it.

getting_around.en: Traffic drives on the left, and drivers should watch for animals and pedestrians.
getting_around.es: Se conduce por la izquierda y los conductores deben estar atentos a animales y peatones.
getting_around.quote: Traffic drives on the left, and drivers should be on increased lookout for animals and pedestrians while driving on the beltway.

getting_around.en: Foreigners need an international driver's licence to drive on Nauru.
getting_around.es: Los extranjeros necesitan un permiso de conducir internacional para conducir en Nauru.
getting_around.quote: Foreigners need an international driver's licence to drive on Nauru.

getting_around.en: Cars or bicycles can sometimes be rented from Capelle and Partners, the largest local supermarket.
getting_around.es: A veces se pueden alquilar coches o bicicletas en Capelle and Partners, el mayor supermercado local.
getting_around.quote: Cars or bicycles can sometimes be rented from Capelle and Partners, the largest local supermarket.

money.quote: Nauru uses the Australian dollar, denoted by the symbol

money.en: Cash transactions are the norm, and credit and debit cards are rarely accepted.
money.es: Lo habitual son las transacciones en efectivo y las tarjetas de crédito y débito rara vez se aceptan.
money.quote: Cash transactions are the norm; credit and debit cards are rarely accepted.

money.en: There is only one ATM on the island, it is often out of cash, and you should take enough Australian dollars in cash.
money.es: Solo hay un cajero automático en la isla, a menudo sin efectivo, y conviene llevar suficientes dólares australianos en efectivo.
money.quote: There is only one ATM on the island – at the Menen Hotel – and it is often out of cash. Credit cards are not accepted. Take enough Australian dollars in cash to cover your trip.

money.en: There are no exchange offices in Nauru, and the single bank office is usually closed.
money.es: No hay oficinas de cambio en Nauru y la única sucursal bancaria suele estar cerrada.
money.quote: There are no exchange offices in Nauru and the single bank office, Bank of Nauru is usually closed.

money.en: Bargaining and tipping are not done on Nauru.
money.es: En Nauru no se regatea ni se da propina.
money.quote: Bargaining or tipping are not done on Nauru.

etiquette.en: Nauru is a predominantly Christian country where Christian values and rules of conduct apply.
etiquette.es: Nauru es un país predominantemente cristiano donde rigen los valores y normas de conducta cristianos.
etiquette.quote: Nauru is a predominantly Christian country, and Christian values and rules of conduct apply.

etiquette.en: Open displays of affection between same-sex partners may offend some in Nauru.
etiquette.es: Las muestras públicas de afecto entre parejas del mismo sexo pueden ofender a algunas personas en Nauru.
etiquette.quote: Open displays of affection between same-sex partners may offend some in Nauru.

etiquette.en: Photographs may not be taken at the Australian processing centre for asylum seekers.
etiquette.es: No se pueden tomar fotografías en el centro australiano de procesamiento de solicitantes de asilo.
etiquette.quote: The one place on the island that you may not take photographs is the Australian processing centre for asylum seekers.

etiquette.en: Importing pornographic material is illegal, and the government also blocks internet porn.
etiquette.es: Importar material pornográfico es ilegal y el gobierno también bloquea la pornografía en internet.
etiquette.quote: It is illegal to import pornographic material, and the government also blocks access to Internet porn.

etiquette.en: It is recommended to wear a sarong or shorts over swimsuits.
etiquette.es: Se recomienda llevar un pareo o pantalones cortos sobre el traje de baño.
etiquette.quote: It is recommended to wear a sarong or shorts over swimsuits.

connectivity.en: There is a mobile phone network, and you may need to buy a SIM card from Digicel if your home operator has no roaming contract with Nauru.
connectivity.es: Hay red de telefonía móvil y puede que debas comprar una SIM de Digicel si tu operador no tiene acuerdo de roaming con Nauru.
connectivity.quote: There are public phones and a mobile phone network. You may need to buy a SIM card from the local operator Digicel if your home operator doesn't have a roaming contract with Nauru.

connectivity.en: CenpacNet is the only Internet provider on Nauru.
connectivity.es: CenpacNet es el único proveedor de internet de Nauru.
connectivity.quote: CenpacNet inc. is the only Internet provider
